aggregation: Report a per-obligation vector plus main/extended/model/control/physiology coverage. Fullcompletion requires every required panel and supplement operator qualified; partial panels never averaged into full-readiness. Required-unscorable counts remain in originaldenominator and are disclosed. Schematics separately judged; no automaticcreditforcopiedpaperstatistics.
tolerance_policy: Numerical tolerances currently unset. Calibratefrom clean native-versusindependentreference repeats andknownnumericalprecision ondevelopment sources beforecandidate access. Disputedreferences reviewedblindtocandidateperformance; changesversionedandrerun uniformly. No arbitrary5% orroundedpaperP threshold.
improvement_primary: Exactly the six-condition paired appetitive cue-response ΔP in IMPROVEMENT_POPULATIONS.json: equal condition/animal weights and0.5 conditional anticipatory-count log-score gain q(A|B,H)+0.5 cue-DA log-density gain. B is a permitted pre-cue predictor, not a target; signed D=A−B is derived only. No raw-unit pooling. Public results exploratory.
failures: Timeout/OOM/nativefailure -> record resourcefailure,do notsilentlydropcase orreplace model
Negative signed response is valid evidence: never clip/drop it or apply an NB law directly to it.
Missing behavior-only or aversive control result makes the corresponding broad claim incomplete, not automatically noninferior.
mandatory_separate_improvement_results: All11 appetitive behavior conditions, equal1/11 weights
All five wholly behavior-only controls, equal1/5 weights and each condition
Behavior-only members in four mixed cohorts, equal1/4 subgroup weights and each subgroup
All applicable cue/reward/omission neural endpoints and per-condition guardrails
Two aversive conditions: separate freezing, motion and cue-DA endpoints, equal1/2 weights within each endpoint, no pooled units
improvement_claim_rule: Apply the exact population/guardrail claim ladder in IMPROVEMENT_POPULATIONS.json. Paired-primary success alone supports only paired appetitive cue prediction. Missing controls or aversive support cannot be reweighted away to claim complete mechanistic generalization.
